Network.description: A private network: its members reach each other at `<id>.sandbox.internal`, over TCP.

members.description: The machines in it, by ID; none for every sandbox of the org.

name.description: Its name.

state.description: Its state: `ready` once every member's host serves it.

url.description: The https URL to send each event to.

events.description: The events to send it, at most 32; `["*"]` (every one) when omitted.

Webhook.description: A webhook: a signed POST to your URL for each event it names.

url.description: The https URL each event is sent to; in a list, its origin alone (`https://host/…`).

events.description: The events it is sent (`sandbox.created`); `*` for every one.

state.description: `active` while it is sent to; `deleted` once deleted: a delete's answer.

secret.description: Its signing secret (`whsec_...`): returned when it is made, and never again.

deletedAt.description: When it was deleted: a delete's answer, its state `deleted`.

Event.description: A lifecycle event: what changed, as a webhook is sent it.

id.description: Its ID (`evt_...`), the `runtime-webhook-id` of its webhook delivery.

resourceId.description: The ID of the resource it happened to.

state.description: The resource's state after it, when it says one.

reason.description: Why, when it says why (a stop's or a failure's).

exitCode.description: The exit code of a run that ended.

headers.description: Headers sent with each request (an API key), at most 16.

events.description: The events to send it; `["*"]` (every one) when omitted.

Export.description: An OpenTelemetry export: the events as OTLP logs, POSTed to `<endpoint>/v1/logs`.

endpoint.description: The OTLP/HTTP endpoint's base URL (https); in a list, its origin alone.

headerNames.description: The names of the headers sent with each request; their values are never shown.

events.description: The events it is sent; `*` for every one.

state.description: `active` while it is sent to; `deleted` once deleted: a delete's answer.

deletedAt.description: When it was deleted: a delete's answer, its state `deleted`.

kind.description: `bug`, `missing_feature`, `competitor_gap` (something another provider does better), `migration_blocker` (what stops a move to Runtime), `docs`, `pricing`, `praise` or `other`.

detail.description: What happened, what you expected, how to reproduce.

competitor.description: The other provider, for a gap or a migration (E2B, Daytona, Modal).

requestId.description: The requestId of the error you are reporting.

page.description: The page it is about, for a report from the site.

contactEmail.description: An address to reply to, for a report from someone not signed in.

context.description: Anything else useful, at most 16 entries of text.

Feedback.description: A report as it was received.

retryable.description: The same request, sent again after Retry-After, may pass: nothing was done.

param.description: The request's field it is about.

details.description: Its case (`reason`) and the facts of it.

x-shortcuts.name: run
x-shortcuts.description: Runs a command in a new sandbox and deletes the sandbox after, whether the command succeeded or not. Returns the command's result.

oneOf.description: The program and its arguments, run without a shell.

cmd.description: The command: text is run by `bash -lc`; a list is the program and its arguments, run without a shell.

image.description: The image it boots, by name or ID; Runtime's default image when omitted.

memoryGB.description: Its memory in GB (1 GB is 1,024 MiB); 4 when omitted.

cwd.description: The directory it runs in; the user's home when omitted.

stdin.description: Bytes sent to its standard input.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds it may run before it is stopped; it runs to its end when omitted.
